notes.title: Update Notes - December 29, 2024
notes.content:
6n23 Update Notes - December 29, 2024

We're excited to announce the latest updates for 6n23! This update focuses on enhancing the leaderboard experience and improving overall game stability. Here’s what’s new:  

1. Leaderboard Enhancements
 A loading feature has been added to the leaderboard, ensuring smoother access and a seamless browsing experience.  
 The leaderboard now displays up to the top 100 players, giving you a broader view of the competition.  

2. Bug Fixes
 Several minor bugs have been addressed to ensure a more polished and stable gameplay experience.  

We hope you enjoy these improvements, and as always, your feedback is invaluable.
